correctness.rationale: PASS: The explicitly normalized positive Cauchy wavelet is a Hardy-space isometry and horizontal-invariant localization is multiplication by m_k(ω)=p_k(e^(−2ω)), p_k(t)=t−t²+t^k−t^(2k). Exact Sturm variation V(0)−V(1)=1 for integers 2≤k≤8; independently rebuilt these seven exact Sturm counts. For all k≥9, signs of p'_k at 1/2,13/20,1−1/k,1 alternate +−+−, and Descartes bounds total positive roots by three; hence exactly three simple roots and one valley. Comparing p_k at t*=2^(−1/k) with upper bound of first peak proves right peak is strict global maximum. Monotone inverse branches yield spectral multiplicity four only on (p_k(r2),p_k(r1)), two elsewhere, no point spectrum. Uniform C² expansion of e^(−x)−e^(−2x)+e^(−x/k)−e^(−2x/k) near x=ln2 gives x*=ln2+2/k+O(k^-2) and the stated 1/k,1/k² norm terms. Finite checks are not proof for all k.
